snippet.title: OUT NOW! Dive into Philna Fantasy — the vibrant pixel RPG adventure on Steam!
snippet.description:
Set in the magical continent of Votland, this love letter to classic RPGs blends nostalgic charm with modern action-RPG thrills. Embark on a 15+ hour handcrafted journey filled with exploration, intense combat, puzzles, and deep character customization.

Choose from 4 unique classes, custom your build, and uncover the mystery of Votland. Traverse lush woodlands, ancient ruins, and dangerous dungeons — with secrets, rare treasures, and a loyal pet companion by your side.

Philna Fantasy is NOW AVAILABLE on Steam! Your epic pixel adventure awaits.#games #indiegame   #arpg  #2d  #gaming #steamgames #
